transcript.text: Bosch integrated dishwasher showing E:15 and the pump keeps running. Model SMV4HTX31E. I've turned it off and on, still there

E:15 on your Bosch means: Water-protection (anti-flood) system activated - water in base pan; drain pump runs, cycle locked (close tap). From what you have described, the most likely cause is is there water in the base, and where is it leaking from (find the source first). Next: Establish whether there is water in the base tray and where it is coming from. Let me know what you find.

I can't pull the unit out or tilt it, it's integrated under the worktop. Looking through a gap in the plinth with a torch I can see a little shine of water in the base tray. No water on the kitchen floor though. Where do I go from here?

Before you start, switch it off and unplug it. Since you can't pull the unit out or tilt it, the next step is one you can do from the front with the door open, which is below. What you find there decides whether we look for a leak source you can reach or whether it needs the unit taken out. Open the door and look all the way round the rubber seal on the tub edge, and along the bottom of the door, for splits, flattened sections or something caught on it. Is the seal damaged, was something caught on it (now removed), or does it look fine?
Door seal looks okay to me, no splits or anything caught on it. Anything else I can check from the front?
From what you have checked, this needs an appliance engineer to look at it: the next steps are beyond the checks that are safe to do yourself.
